name: Have you documented the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements that must be met by the service?
requirementTitle: Have you documented the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements that must be met by the service?
requirementDescription: Have you created a list of all the rules, laws, regulations and contractual commitments that the service must comply with?
why:
Teams cannot comply with requirements they have not identified.
The obligations profile should be documented and shared across the project.
tasks: Have you documented the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements that must be met by the service?

actions.title: Have you documented the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements that must be met by the service?
actions.description:
You should maintain a record showing:
• Applicable laws
• Regulations
• Government policies
• Standards
• Contract obligations
